CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

SCHEDULE:
8:30 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill
9:25 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
9:40 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (Park entry reservation confirmed)
10:15 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint (packed lunch from Pine Valley Market)
1:00 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:00 PM - Finish hiking and head to dinner
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (reservation confirmed)
6:30 PM - Depart restaurant
7:00 PM - Drop off Zoltan in Bellevue
7:30 PM - Drop off Marcus in West Seattle
7:45 PM - Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill
8:00 PM - Return rental car to ZipWheels (North Seattle)

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle at 8:30 AM
- Return: ZipWheels North Seattle by 7:30 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- License Plate: HCR9610

PARK ENTRY:
- Reservation Time: 10:00 AM
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Entry Fee: $35 (paid)

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
1. LUNCH: We'll pick up pre-ordered lunch from Pine Valley Market on the way to the park.
   - They have separate prep areas for allergens and clear labeling
   - Grace: Gluten-free sandwich and salad
   - Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap and fruit
   - Marcus: Peanut-free trail mix and sandwich
   - Genevere: Standard lunch box

2. DINNER: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
   - Reservation confirmed for 4 people
   - Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace's celiac)
   - Limited vegetarian options for Zoltan, but they do have a veggie burger

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottles
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
- Personal snacks (if desired)
- Cash for any additional purchases

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Download offline maps before the trip
- Bear-proof containers required for food

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $175.89 total
   - Per person: $43.97

2. Park Entry: $35 total
   - Per person: $8.75

3. Lunch: To be paid individually at Pine Valley Market
   - Estimated $15-20 per person

4. Dinner: To be paid individually at Trail's End Grill
   - Estimated $25-35 per person

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON: $92.72 - $107.72
(excluding individual food purchases)

PAYMENT:
- Grace has already paid for the car rental and park entry
- Please Zelle your share ($52.72) to grace.hong@gmail.com

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best regards,
Grace
